## Mermaid Diagrams

When the user asks to create, edit, or visualize a diagram, follow the
instructions in `.github/instructions/mermaid.instructions.md`. If that
referenced instructions file is not available in context, generate valid
Mermaid diagram syntax using best practices and ask the user to confirm the
diagram type.
<!-- mermaid-ai-skills:end -->
